aws.account_context: User confirmed the account switch was intentional; historical inventory from the previous account does not describe this account.

public_portal.meaning: Public endpoint is reachable; this does not identify the active AWS account or prove RDS, ALB targets, ASG, or WAF health.

lifecycle_automation.reason: AWS and Azure use separate lifecycle roots and the current AWS policy blocks inventory reconciliation; no destructive cross-cloud wrapper was run.
